description: Scenario evals for the okf skill. Run each in a fresh temporary directory: write the listed files, run the setup commands there, then give the agent the prompt with the okf skill installed. Grade the transcript and the final files against the assertions. Run every scenario once on a small and once on a large model.

evals.name: stale-index-retrieval-with-superseded-decision

files.content:
# Types

| Type | Use for |
|---|---|
| `Decision` | A decision |

# Decisions

Database and platform decisions.

## Contents

<!-- okf:index -->
<!-- /okf:index -->

---
type: Decision
title: Use MySQL for orders
description: Orders are stored in MySQL.
superseded_by: /eng/decisions/use-postgres.md
---

# Use MySQL for orders

Orders are stored in MySQL.

setup: write cat/eng/decisions/use-postgres.md: frontmatter type Decision, title 'Use Postgres for orders', description 'Orders moved from MySQL to Postgres.', body stating the move; do not rebuild the index
evals.prompt: Using the OKF catalogue in ./cat: which database stores our orders?
evals.expected_output: Postgres, citing eng/decisions/use-postgres and noting that the MySQL decision is superseded.
assertions: Keeps stderr visible and reacts to the note 'lexical index is stale' by running build-index, or reads the superseded_by target directly
Writes no file other than the search index

evals.name: add-decision-and-rename-without-mv

files.content:
# Types

| Type | Use for |
|---|---|
| `Decision` | A decision |
| `Concept` | An idea |

# Decisions

Database and platform decisions.

## Contents

<!-- okf:index -->
<!-- /okf:index -->

---
type: Decision
title: Old database
description: The first database choice.
---

# Old database

We started on MySQL.

---
type: Concept
title: Overview
description: Entry page.
---

# Overview

See [the old decision](/eng/decisions/old-db.md).

evals.prompt: In the OKF catalogue ./cat, record the decision that orders now live in Postgres because MySQL lacked the JSON features we need, and rename eng/decisions/old-db.md to eng/decisions/use-mysql-legacy.md.
evals.expected_output: A new Decision concept in eng/decisions, the old concept renamed with its inbound link in eng/overview.md rewritten, listings regenerated, check clean, no commit.
assertions: Renames with okf-cli rename: a preview run first, then --apply; never mv, git mv or rm
The new concept has type Decision, a one-sentence description and generated.by naming the agent itself, not an invented human
Runs reindex and ends with check reporting 'OK — 0 violations'
Creates no git commit, because the user did not ask for one

files.content:
# Types

| Type | Use for |
|---|---|
| `Metric` | A measurable quantity |

# Finance

Finance metrics.

## Concepts

* [Revenue](metrics/revenue.md) - Recognized revenue.

---
type: Metric
title: Revenue
description: Recognized revenue for a fiscal year.
tags: [finance]
timestamp: '2026-05-28T22:53:05+00:00'
author: alice
---

Revenue sums amount per fiscal year. See [the handbook](../handbook.md).

# Citations

- https://wiki.example/finance/revenue-recognition

evals.prompt: Upgrade the finance bundle in the OKF catalogue ./cat to OKF v0.2.
evals.expected_output: finance/metrics/revenue.md carries generated and sources with a footnote, no timestamp, no Citations section; the subdirectory has a managed index.md; check --strict is clean or every remaining warning is reported; no verified or stale_after invented.
assertions: Runs the phase 0 baseline (check, reindex --check, grep) before editing
Asks the user whether alice wrote the current text, or keeps author as an extra key, instead of assuming
Converts timestamp to generated.at with the same instant
Moves the Citations item into sources with an id and cites it with a footnote
Adds no verified entry and no stale_after without a user statement
Creates finance/metrics/index.md with markers and converts finance/index.md to a managed listing
Reports the unresolved link to ../handbook.md instead of inventing a target
Creates no git commit unless the user asked for commits
